Inlined the three feature-flags sub-components (web ../components/feature-flags/{FlagsTable,FlagEditDrawer,ChangesPanel}) directly into the page because they are NOT in the native conversion manifest and would otherwise leave the import unresolved. Every prop, predicate, JSON rule, and i18n key was ported verbatim: FlagsTable.previewValue (null->'null', undefined->'—', string->JSON.stringify, boolean/number->String, else JSON.stringify with 120-char truncation -> '…'); ChangesPanel.compact (nullish->'—', JSON.stringify with 60-char truncation); ChangesPanel.OP_VARIANT {set:'success',delete:'danger'} (with the defensive '?? neutral' fallback preserved via a Partial view for type-safety); FlagEditDrawer.defaultValueJson (JSON.stringify(value,null,2) or ''); FlagsTable useSortToggle('key','asc') + [...rows].sort((a,b)=>a.key.localeCompare(b.key)*dir) reproduced as a tappable asc/desc sort header; the FlagEditDrawer keyInput/valueInput/reason state, the open re-seed useEffect, the parsed {ok,value,error} useMemo (empty->valueEmpty, JSON.parse->ok, catch->valueInvalid {{msg}}), keyValid/reasonValid/canSave gating, editing=initial!==null immutable-key disable+hint, and handleSave guard.

Preserved every identifier, state name, API path, and i18n contract verbatim: state editorOpen/editing/pendingDelete/deleteReason; the useFlags/useFlagChanges(null,50)/useSetFlag/useDeleteFlag bindings; handler bodies and the exact mutateAsync call shapes setFlag.mutateAsync({key,value,reason}) and deleteFlag.mutateAsync({key:pendingDelete.key,reason:deleteReason.trim()}); the flags.data?.flags??[] / changes.data?.rows??[] reads; setFlag.isPending / deleteFlag.isPending. API paths are unchanged because the unmodified native useFeatureFlags hooks (GET/PUT/DELETE /system/flags, /system/flags/{key}, /system/flags/changes?limit=) are reused. Every t(key, defaultString[, vars]) key is kept verbatim — admin.flags.pageTitle/subtitle/actions.add/actions.edit/actions.delete/panels.registry/panels.changes/cols.key/cols.value/cols.actions/table.loading/table.empty/audit.cols.{changedAt,actor,flagKey,operation,oldValue,newValue,reason}/audit.empty.{title,globalMessage,scopedMessage}/audit.loading/editor.{keyLabel,keyPlaceholder,keyImmutable,valueLabel,valueEmpty,valueInvalid,reasonLabel,reasonPlaceholder}/drawer.{editTitle,createTitle,save}/delete.{title,message,reasonLabel,reasonPlaceholder,confirm}/common.cancel — through a native key/English-default `t` fallback (react-i18next is not wired on native) that returns the English default and applies the same {{key}}/{{msg}} interpolation as the web `t`.

DOM/web-UI swaps — no DOM, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, lucide-react, or old web UI imports: PageContainer (title/subtitle/actions + query freshness) -> an inline scaffold; the web page passes NO `loading` prop so children always render and each panel owns its own loading/empty state, reproduced exactly. usePageTitle drives document.title (no RN analogue) so the translated title is surfaced as the on-screen accessibilityRole="header" page header. query={flags} -> the web DataFreshnessAuto chip is represented by the shared native FreshnessIndicator driven by flags.dataUpdatedAt (rendered only once the query has fetched). FadeIn (framer-motion) -> a plain View. SectionErrorBoundary -> a native SectionBoundary class error boundary (getDerivedStateFromError) preserving the name + the t('errors.section.subtitle','Other parts of the page should still work.') fallback. GlassPanel -> native GlassPanel; PanelTitle + lucide Flag/History -> a PanelHeader (SemanticIcon name='flag'/'history' + title). Button primary/secondary/danger (sm/md, lucide Plus/Pencil/Trash2, loading, disabled) -> a native Pressable TextButton preserving every variant/size/disabled/loading state (ActivityIndicator while loading; glyphs +, ✎, ✕). DataTable (FlagsTable + ChangesPanel) -> mobile card lists (the APIKeysPage precedent): FlagsTable keeps the sortable key column as an asc/desc toggle (↑/↓) and renders key(mono)/value-preview(mono)/Edit+Delete per row; ChangesPanel renders the EmptyState (scoped vs global message) then a card per change with changed_at, an OP Badge(set->success/delete->danger), actor(mono), flag_key(mono), old/new compact previews, and reason — DataTable pagination is omitted (all rows render). TimeStamp format="absolute" -> an inlined absolute formatter ('Apr 4, 2:30 AM' via toLocaleString, '—' on nullish/NaN). Drawer (right slide-in side panel with title bar + scroll body + footer) -> an RN slide Modal panel anchored right (maxWidth 520) with the same header(title+close)/scrollable 3-section body(key,value JSON textarea,reason)/footer(Cancel+Save) structure; Input -> labelled TextInput (onChange e.target.value -> onChangeText), Textarea rows=8 + error -> a multiline monospace TextInput with an inline danger error line. Modal size="sm" -> an inline transparent fade RN Modal (backdrop + capped-width dialog) preserving the {{key}} message, the reason Input, and the Cancel/Delete gating + the isPending-gated onClose. Tailwind text-[var(--text-*)] colours map to theme tokens (textPrimary/textSecondary/textMuted) and neon success/danger map to successSurface/danger tokens. testIDs cover every slot: feature-flags-page/-add-button/-freshness, flags-registry-panel/-changes-panel, flags-table/-table-empty/-sort-key, flag-row-<key>/flag-edit-<key>/flag-delete-<key>, flag-changes-table/-changes-empty/-changes-loading, flag-change-row-<id>/flag-op-<op>, flag-edit-drawer/flag-drawer-close/flag-key-input/flag-value-input/flag-value-error/flag-reason-input/flag-save-button/flag-cancel-button, flag-delete-modal/-delete-reason-input/-delete-confirm-button/-delete-cancel-button, section-error-<name>.

Gates: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` all pass (21 suites / 93 tests, no open handles).
